description: This file defines the EmailSubscriberDao class, which interacts with email subscription and subscriber entities within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to retrieve, save, and delete email subscribers, as well as fetch email subscription details by ID.

classes.name: EmailSubscriberDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for EmailSubscriber entities, providing methods to retrieve, create, delete, and count email subscribers, and fetch related email notification details.

methods.name: getEmailSubscribersByEmailSubscriptionId
methods.description: Fetches an array of EmailSubscriber objects associated with a specific email subscription ID, applying optional search filters.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriberByEmailSubscriptionIdPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a Paginator object for email subscribers filtered by email subscription ID and search parameters.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriberListCountByEmailSubscriptionId
methods.description: Returns the count of email subscribers associated with a specific email subscription ID based on search filters.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriptionById
methods.description: Retrieves an EmailNotification entity by its ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: saveEmailSubscriber
methods.description: Persists a new or updated EmailSubscriber entity to the database.

methods.name: getEmailSubscriberById
methods.description: Retrieves an EmailSubscriber entity based on subscriber ID and subscription ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmailSubscriberIds
methods.description: Returns an array of existing email subscriber IDs from a provided list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmailSubscribersByIds
methods.description: Deletes email subscribers matching the provided list of IDs and returns the number of deletions.
